label: late original steps (t=7-9) of long sequences starting with o/d/u/p/a
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.03% of steps). It only fires at absolute steps 7-9 in the original or delimiter phase, mostly in L=9 sequences (80% of mass) and L=8, and peaks on the last original token (t=8) and the <DEL> that follows. It never fires in the copy phase or before t=5. The first original token strongly gates it: o (10.8x lift) > d > u > p > a. The second token being o/p/3/f also helps. The current input token matters little. Even with these conditions precision stays low (about 2-8%), so whatever else decides which of these slots fire was not captured. The predicate covers about 83% of activation mass on dev. Within the window the largest activations fall on t=8 tokens, but I did not check magnitude in detail.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=o (+5.26), orig0=d (+4.47), orig0=u (+3.85), to_go=1 (+3.39), orig0=p (+3.32), orig1=o (+3.30). Lower it: phase=2 (-8.36), next_out=- (-5.17), orig2=d (-2.69), orig6=- (-2.68).
